== Biography ==
John, [[Glasgow-1440|Patrick Glasgow]] and [[Fairburn-170|Helen Fairburn]], was born on 5 april 1708 and baptised on 2 May 1708 in Stichill Parish, Roxburghshire, Scotland.<ref>"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] (accessed 3 August 2026), John Glasgow born or baptised on 2 May 1708, son of Patrick Glasgow & Helen Fairbairn, in Stichill and Hume, Roxburghshire, Scotland; citing Parish Number 808, Ref 10/274, Frame 144.</ref><ref>"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950," database, {{FamilySearch Record|FMMW-9QR}} (accessed 3 August 2026), John Glasgow baptism on 2 May 1708 (born 5), son of Patrick Glasgow & Helen Fairbairn, in Stitchel, Roxburghshire, Scotland; citing Digital film/folder number: 7; FHL microfilm: 1067952.</ref>
